name: IDEA Lab Canvas Editorial Checker
description: Read-only last-hurdle editorial checker for Canvas LMS course content. Click the toolbar icon on a Canvas Page, Assignment, Discussion or Syllabus to flag obvious errors and House Style and Conventions Guide compliance issues (house style, formatting, inclusive language). Runs entirely in your browser — no data leaves your machine, no API keys, nothing is ever edited.
